title: Shower Door Pull 13-Inch Solid Brass & Acrylic | Brass Shower Door Accessories | Allied Brass
description:
Get a secure, comfortable grip for opening and closing your glass shower door with a pull that looks clean and intentional in any bathroom.

Highlights:
- Keep your shower entry easy to use every day with a single-side, U-shaped pull designed for glass shower doors of many sizes and styles
- Maintain a crisp, finished look with concealed screw mounting hardware
- Add enduring strength in a wet environment with solid brass construction and clear acrylic accent components
- Coordinate with transitional bathroom hardware by pairing it with other versatile bath accessories from the Brass Shower Door Accessories collection

Specs & Installation:
- Product type: Clearview Collection single side shower door pull with smooth accents
- Materials: Solid brass with clear acrylic accents
- Dimensions (L x H x W): 13 x 3.9 x 1.7 in.
- Box dimensions (L x H x W): 14 x 6 x 6 in.
- Shipping weight: 4 lbs
- Mounting: Concealed screw mounting; installation hardware included
- Finish: Available in multiple designer finish options
- Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
